info.title: Showcase API
info.description: Multi-tenant backend for product showcase websites. `/public/v1` serves read-only, CDN-cacheable content for static site generation; `/admin/v1` manages websites, products and publishing.

Created as `draft` with a default theme. Add and verify a primary domain, then
enable it.
Needed for sites with `auto_publish=false`; merges into a pending job if any.

Response List Domains Admin V1 Websites  Website Id  Domains Get

post.description:
The response contains the DNS TXT record to create for verification. The first
domain of a website becomes its primary domain.
